tools.name: request_viewing
tools.description: Ask JIR Ventures to arrange a viewing of a property, or to get in touch about it. Send the listing_id and the contact details of the person who is interested; JIR Ventures replies to them directly. Only send details the person has agreed to share.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get the full details of one JIR Ventures property listing by its listing_id, as returned by search_listings.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: List every property JIR Ventures currently has available in Damascus, Syria and Rif Dimashq: offices and homes for rent or sale. Each listing has a listing_id, property type, deal type (rent or sale), district, size in square metres, rooms, price, currency and description. Use a listing_id with get_
